root_cause.text: The VM_BIND UNMAP path passed `op->obj_offset` instead of `op->range` to `drm_gpuvm_sm_unmap_exec_lock`, causing the locking function to not properly acquire locks on the buffer objects involved in the unmapping operation.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff changes `drm_gpuvm_sm_unmap_exec_lock(job->vm, exec, op->iova, op->obj_offset)` to `... op->iova, op->range)`. The commit message states: "Wrong argument meant that the objs involved in UNMAP ops were not always getting locked."
